title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are. Who We Are We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included. As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few! Job Description Your Career The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies. Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio. Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting
Qualifications Your Experience
  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals
Additional Information The Team Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients. As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step. Our Commitment We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

  • Familiaridade com conceitos de transformação digital, TICs, Big Data, software, IoT, e-commerce e marketing digital.
  • Nível intermediário-avançado em CRM, Microsoft Office e softwares de produtividade em vendas.

O que oferecemos? Razões para se juntar à nossa equipe

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Salário base competitivo + as melhores comissões do mercado.

title: Especialista Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.

Oportunidade: Especialista Azure

A PSM Company busca um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para atuar em soluções avançadas na plataforma Microsoft Azure . A posição exige sólida experiência em arquitetura, governança e operação de ambientes corporativos em nuvem, com ênfase em Azure Network , infraestrutura e mecanismos de segurança.

Responsabilidades

  • Estruturar arquiteturas em Azure envolvendo Compute, Network, Storage, Monitoring e Security, garantindo desempenho, confiabilidade e conformidade.
  • Implementar ambientes utilizando VMs, VMSS, AKS, App Services, Functions, pipelines de imagem e automações baseadas em Bicep/Terraform.
  • Projetar topologias de rede complexas, incluindo VNets, Subnets, NSG/ASG, Private Link, Application Gateway, Firewall, Front Door, Load Balancer e conectividade híbrida via VPN ou ExpressRoute.
  • Administrar soluções de armazenamento, contemplando Blob, ADLS Gen2, Azure Files, discos gerenciados, replicação, políticas de ciclo de vida e mecanismos de proteção.
  • Operar ferramentas de observabilidade, configurando logs, métricas, alertas, diagnósticos, KQL e integrações automatizadas.
  • Aplicar práticas de segurança baseadas em Zero Trust, controle de acesso, criptografia, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud e políticas corporativas.
  • Apoiar diretrizes de governança, otimização de custos, nomenclatura, conformidade e padrões arquiteturais.
  • Atuar em integrações com ambientes on-premise, contemplando DNS, DHCP, File Server, clustering e recursos relacionados.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Domínio comprovado em Azure Network (mandatório).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em virtualização, dimensionamento, containers, disponibilidade, continuidade e workloads especializados.
  • Experiência em automação, gestão de configuração, atualização e pipelines de provisionamento.
  • Competência para operar ferramentas de monitoramento e execução de análises avançadas.
  • Sólida compreensão de identidade, políticas, governança e modelos de segurança.
  • Vivência em ambientes híbridos e de grande escala.

title: Software Engineer (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI)
description:
Role: Software Engineer – Investments (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI))

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Hours: CST

About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our Investments Technology team , helping design and build secure, scalable healthcare and identity management platforms . You’ll work across the stack using C#, .NET 8+, Azure , and Angular , while leveraging GitHub Copilot and other GenAI tools to accelerate development and innovation.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and Build Scalable Solutions: Develop secure, high-performance applications using C#, .NET 8+, Entity Framework , and SQL .

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building production-grade applications with C# and .NET Core/8+ .
  • Strong understanding of REST , event-driven , and microservice architectures.
  • Experience with Azure App Service, Service Bus, and APIM .
  • Proficiency in SQL and Entity Framework for database interactions.
  • Front-end experience with Angular, TypeScript, and HTML .
  • Expertise with OpenAPI/Swagger for API documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or similar GenAI tools.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills in remote, cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) or other IAM platforms.
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (HIPAA) and secure data handling.
  • Exposure to Azure Event Hubs , Kafka , or AutoGen frameworks.

title: Interdisciplinary Project Teacher: Science, Grades 6-8
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

WHY TEACH AT AVENUES?

Avenues | The World School prepares students for engaged global citizenship during a time of unprecedented complexity and accelerating change, combining language immersion, interdisciplinary learning, a global curriculum, and a culture of creativity and deep collaboration.

DEEP COLLABORATION, CONSTANT EVOLUTION

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.

SECONDARY DIVISION

The Middle and Upper Grades are where our ambitious goals for Avenues graduates, defined in our mission statement , are most comprehensively realized. While in grades 6-12, we prepare students for a globally connected, innovation-driven, and largely unknown future. Our students will be: accomplished in all the academic skills you would expect, at ease beyond their borders, and confident because they excel in a particular passion.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

At Avenues, science project teachers work closely with colleagues to design and enact interdisciplinary learning experiences as part of a teaching team within a grade level. In their role as part of a project team, teachers ensure that students act as scientists every day: asking questions, conducting experiments, and learning deeply from the world around them. :

● Ensure that students achieve key learning outcomes, targeting instruction to address individual needs

● Build a learning atmosphere that leads students to feel part of a rigorous and joyful learning community

● Collaborate intensively with colleagues to design interdisciplinary projects and continually deepen student learning

● Inspire trust and confidence among parents and families

Qualifications

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Science teachers at Avenues bring all or most of the following:

● A burning desire to work as part of a project-based, interdisciplinary team

● A remarkable entrepreneurial drive, creativity and ability to bring new ideas to fruition

● Intellectual curiosity and humility, to reflect on and continually grow in teaching practice

● Strong content knowledge in general physical and life sciences, as well as one or more specialized topics (e.g. astronomy, environmental science, engineering, etc.)

● Pedagogy that engages all students in interesting, meaningful and challenging work

● Experience teaching science, with clear evidence of student learning and growth

● A strong sense of personal responsibility for the success of every student

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Senior Software QA Engineer

Location: Brazil Fully Remote

Reports To: Head of QA/ Engineering Manager

Setup: Consultancy/PJ

Must Have: English Resume and Professional level of English Communication Skills

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Sr QA Engineer with strong experience in both automated and manual testing. This role is critical to ensuring our products meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and user experience. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to design and execute test plans, build automated test suites, and champion quality across the entire software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test Planning & Execution
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, and potential risks.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans and test cases covering functional, regression, integration, and performance scenarios.
  • Perform manual testing for exploratory, usability, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Test Automation
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites (UI, API, and regression).
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality feedback.
  • Monitor and maintain test results, ensuring failures are triaged quickly.
  • Defect Tracking & Reporting
  • Log, prioritize, and track defects using issue tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Azure Linear).
  • Partner with developers to reproduce, debug, and verify fixes.
  • Provide clear reporting on test coverage, pass/fail rates, and quality trends.
  • Quality Advocacy
  • Participate in design reviews, backlog grooming, and sprint planning to identify potential issues early.
  • Suggest process improvements to enhance efficiency and prevent defects.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a QA Engineer, Software Tester, or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in writing automated tests using frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar .
  • Experience testing APIs using tools like Postman , REST Assured, or similar.
  • Solid understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI).
  • Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Why Join Us

  • Work with a collaborative, high-performing engineering team that values quality at every step.
  • Opportunity to shape and improve our test automation strategy and quality processes.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and opportunities for career growth.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
A Hexagon:

A Hexagon é líder global em soluções de realidade digital, combinando sensores, software e tecnologias autônomas. Utilizamos dados para contribuir para a eficiência, a produtividade, a qualidade e a segurança em aplicações industriais, de fabricação, infraestrutura, setor público e mobilidade.

Nossas tecnologias estão moldando os ecossistemas de produção e relacionados às pessoas para se tornarem cada vez mais conectados e independentes — garantindo um futuro escalável e sustentável.

A divisão de Mineração da Hexagon resolve os desafios de minas subterrâneas e de superfície com tecnologias comprovadas para planejamento, operações e segurança.

A Hexagon (Nasdaq Estocolmo: HEXA B) tem aproximadamente 24.000 funcionários em 50 países e vendas líquidas de aproximadamente US$ 5,5 bilhões. Saiba mais em hexagon.com e siga-nos em @HexagonAB.

Objetivo da vaga:

Buscamos um Arquiteto de Soluções habilidades e conhecimentos para integrar nossa equipe dinâmica e criativa. Como Arquiteto de Soluções com foco no setor de transporte de mineração, você trabalhará sob a supervisão do nosso Arquiteto de Soluções Principal. Você terá um papel crucial na criação e no gerenciamento de soluções complexas e inovadoras para atender às necessidades de nossos clientes em nossa área de gestão de frotas. Essa função exige conhecimento profundo tanto de TO (tecnologia operacional) quanto de TI (tecnologia da informação), além de experiência sólida na definição/análise de requisitos, no projeto de soluções escaláveis e seguras, no trabalho com equipes multifuncionais e na integração de sistemas.

Principais áreas de responsabilidade:

  • Trabalhar com clientes e stakeholders internos (incluindo especialistas em transporte rodoviário) para entender suas necessidades de negócios e transformá-las em soluções técnicas completas. Criar arquiteturas de soluções seguras e observáveis que abranjam questões de software, hardware, infraestrutura de dados, integração e infraestrutura.
  • Atuar como ponte entre o negócio e a tecnologia em todas as etapas do ciclo de vida do produto e do projeto. Orientar e liderar técnicos as equipes de desenvolvimento, garantindo que sigam as melhores práticas, os padrões do setor, os padrões atualizados e as proteções.
  • Seja especialista em tecnologias para transporte de minérios. Acompanhe os últimos desenvolvimentos na área e usos para projetar soluções criativas e eficazes.
  • Trabalhe com equipes de desenvolvimento para conectar nossas soluções de gestão de frotas a plataformas e sistemas existentes. Crie interfaces, APIs e fluxos de trabalho de dados para facilitar a comunicação e a transferência de dados.
  • Analise sobreposições entre nossos produtos de gerenciamento de frotas e sugira possíveis maneiras de integrá-los em uma solução unificada.
  • Rever os processos de implantação e definir um roteiro para alinhar as melhores práticas da empresa.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes (internos e externos), atuando como consultores de confiança. Conduzir workshops, apresentações e reuniões para comunicar conceitos e soluções técnicas de forma eficaz. Abordar proativamente as preocupações dos clientes e fornecer recomendações para atualizar seu cenário tecnológico.
  • Trabalhar com arquitetos de sistemas para produzir documentação técnica detalhada, como diagramas de arquitetura de sistemas, especificações de sistemas e diretrizes de melhorias. Manter documentação atualizada e disponível para equipes internas e partes interessadas.
  • Avaliar e refinar continuamente as soluções atuais, encontrando maneiras de melhorar, dimensionar e melhorar o desempenho.
  • Colabore estreitamente com equipes multifuncionais, incluindo desenvolvedores, gerentes de projeto e analistas de negócios, para garantir a integração perfeita das soluções.
  • Mantenha-se atualizado sobre novas tecnologias, tendências do setor e requisitos regulatórios relacionados à mineração e sistemas autônomos. Aprimore nossas soluções com inovações e inovação inovação sobre inovações futuras.

Conhecimentos e experiências:

  • Bacharelado ou mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área correlata.
  • Grande experiência como Arquiteto de Software, projetando e implementando soluções técnicas complexas.
  • Sólido conhecimento de arquitetura de sistemas, metodologias de desenvolvimento de software, soluções IoT e tecnologias de nuvem (como AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud Platform).
  • Forte compreensão dos conceitos de compartilhamento de dados, configuração, segurança e controle de acesso
  • Experiência com aprendizado de máquina e com soluções de automação veicular são desejáveis.
  • Experiência com microsserviços, APIs e padrões de integração.
  • Excelentes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas, com capacidade de avaliar desafios técnicos complexos e fornecer soluções eficazes.
  • Habilidades especialização de comunicação e interpessoal, com capacidade de apresentar conceitos técnicos para partes interessadas técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Fortes habilidades de liderança, com capacidade de orientar e orientar membros da equipe.
  • Certificações relevantes, como AWS/Azure Certified Solutions Architect, são altamente desejáveis
  • Forte compreensão de tecnologias de georreferenciamento, telemetria e soluções embarcadas
  • A compreensão do domínio de mineração de carga e transporte, incluindo entrega de materiais, processos de carga e descarga, é uma grande vantagem
  • É um diferencial experiência com o desenvolvimento de software de automação industrial
  • Inglês avançado

Viagem:

  • 5-10%

Junte-se à nossa equipe como Arquiteto de Soluções e cause um impacto significativo nas iniciativas de transformação digital dos nossos clientes. Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho estimulante, remunerações competitivas e oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Candidate-se agora e ajude a moldar o futuro das soluções tecnológicas da Hexagon.

A Hexagon é uma empresa que promove igualdade de oportunidades. Proibimos a discriminação contra candidatos com base em características protegidas.

description:

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

Missão do Cargo

Fornecer assessoria jurídica estratégica e especializada em temas relacionados ao setor de energia renovável, concessões, Parcerias Público-Privadas (PPPs) e projetos greenfield em infraestrutura e energia. title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Salary = ~30-45k BRL

Company Description

Cubbo is a tech-driven platform that helps business grow. We empower retailers, ecommerce, fintech, banking, direct selling, and multi-level marketing (MLM) companies to deliver faster while reducing costs and increasing customer loyalty. Our platform integrates a crm, warehousing, inventory management, fulfillment, and last-mile logistics into one seamless experience. By managing all carriers and providing advanced tools, Cubbo helps brands scale profitably. Our mission is to give every company in Latin America the power to offer world-class fulfillment, creating long-term growth through speed, reliability, and customer-first logistics.

Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for an Engineering Manager located in São Paulo, Brazil. Our office is based in Pinheiros. The Engineering Manager will be responsible for overseeing engineering projects, managing software development processes, and leading a team of engineers. Day-to-day tasks include project management, integrating various systems, and ensuring seamless collaboration among team members. The role also involves setting goals, monitoring progress, and facilitating technical discussions to drive innovation and efficiency.

Outcomes (What success looks like in year one)

  1. Team Growth & Leadership – Build, mentor, and retain a team of high-performing engineers in São Paulo. Achieve an employee engagement score of 8/10+.
  2. Delivery Excellence – Ensure the team consistently delivers product increments on time with high quality, hitting 90%+ of sprint commitments.
  3. System Reliability – Improve uptime and reduce critical incidents (target: <1% downtime, <2 major incidents per quarter).
  4. Scalable Architecture – Partner with product and leadership to define and deliver a roadmap that scales our platform for 10x volume growth.
  5. Engineering Processes – Implement effective agile practices, code review standards, and CI/CD pipelines to reduce cycle time by 30%.
  6. Cross-Team Collaboration – Establish strong collaboration with product, design, and operations teams in Mexico and Brazil, with positive feedback from stakeholders.

Competencies

  • Technical Leadership – Strong software engineering background, ideally in logistics, SaaS, or high-scale platforms.
  • People Leadership – Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams, fostering career growth, and building culture.
  • Execution Focused – Bias for shipping and iterating quickly while maintaining quality.
  • System Thinker – Able to design and guide implementation of scalable, reliable systems.
  • Clear Communicator – Fluent in English and Portuguese; able to align local teams with global leadership.
  • Founder Mindset – Resourceful, entrepreneurial, comfortable working in fast-moving startup environments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the use of AI-coding tools.
  • Lead and manage the engineering team in São Paulo (hiring, mentoring, performance reviews, team culture).
  • Drive execution of the product roadmap in collaboration with product and design teams.
  • Establish and maintain high engineering standards: code quality, testing, security, and scalability.
  • Own team ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, retros) and foster a strong agile culture.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for leadership, providing visibility on progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Partner with product leadership to balance speed vs. quality trade-offs.
  • Build a strong engineering culture that attracts top talent in Brazil.

description:
Staff Software Engineer – .Net / AWS

Location: Fully remote (based in Brazil)

Work Flexibility: Opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for certain periods

Salary: $7,000-$9,000 per month

Role Overview

We are looking for a seasoned Staff Software Engineer who brings advanced technical acumen and an ability to take broad ownership. This is a predominantly development-focused role (approx. 90 % coding, 10 % DevOps) suited to someone who wants to be accountable for both crafting software and maintaining its operational integrity.

In this position you will help drive the evolution of a large-scale identity and access management platform, modernize legacy components, solve deep technical challenges, and provide mentorship to other engineers. If you relish complex systems and enjoy making code resilient, maintainable and efficient, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Investigate and resolve non-trivial system problems that traverse multiple services, systems or environments.
  • Quickly acquaint yourself with unfamiliar large codebases, often with little prior documentation.
  • Guide and coach other engineers in software architecture, debugging methodologies and technical design.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and QA functions to trace issues across deployment pipelines, APIs and operational environments.
  • Refactor and enhance existing modules to increase performance, reliability and maintainability.
  • Create and maintain documentation of key technical findings, and build diagnostic and troubleshooting frameworks that can be reused.

Required Skills & Background

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in professional software engineering, delivering production-grade systems.
  • Expert proficiency in C# and .NET (Framework 4.8 and/or .NET 10+) , with an emphasis on clean, secure, scalable code.
  • Strong experience with SQL and relational database systems (e.g., MSSQL, MySQL), along with exposure to ElasticSearch and Redis .
  • Demonstrated ability to design, build and optimise distributed, high-volume data flows and integration patterns.
  • Solid familiarity with IIS , Docker , Kubernetes (EKS) , and containerization on both Windows and Linux platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS (including but not limited to EKS, EC2, RDS, S3, CloudWatch).
  • Practical experience working with CI/CD and automation tools such as GitHub Actions , TeamCity , Terraform .
  • Awareness of monitoring and security tools such as Prometheus , Grafana , GuardDuty , AWS Inspector , New Relic .
  • Strong experience aross leadership, mentoring & documentation.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills and ability to thrive in a fast-moving, cross-functional engineering environment.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote working arrangement from Brazil.
  • Flexibility to work from anywhere in the world for certain periods each year.
  • Flexible working hours aligned to outcomes rather than fixed location or schedule.
  • Supportive engineering culture.

title: Operation Strategy
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.

Job Responsibilities

  1. Strategy Formulation: Based on the characteristics of SMB and SAKA business structures, clarify strategies around different dimensions such as merchant basic information, review, and menus; identify key indicators, key initiatives, and implementation paths to ensure strategy feasibility.
  2. Strategy Implementation: Transform strategies into practical approaches suitable for frontline teams, rationally break down objectives, assign them to specific individuals and actions; coordinate resources to resolve key bottlenecks, ensuring strategies truly drive team members to achieve business goals. Coordinate and resolve cross-departmental collaboration and execution obstacles to ensure efficient implementation and a closed-loop process at each key stage.
  3. Strategy Evaluation and Iteration: Evaluate strategy effectiveness through data review and performance evaluation; propose adjustments to inefficient processes, forming a closed-loop strategy iteration system to continuously optimize city-level business.
  4. Resource and Tool Development: Develop SOPs for the entire business process. Create exclusive sales scripts, brand service reports, and case studies for chain merchants, forming replicable and efficient signing and closing strategies.
  5. Performance Scheme Development: Utilize data as a management tool to participate in the development of performance evaluation schemes for each module. Performance and incentives: Address sales momentum. Based on the goals at different stages, design new contract performance and incentive programs to stimulate sales momentum and drive efficient achievement of targets.

Job Requirements

  1. Education Background: Bachelor's degree or above.
  2. Work Experience: (Hard Requirements) At least 3 years of relevant work experience in the internet industry; (Hard Requirements) Familiarity with sales processes and rhythms, experience in strategy development and incentive mechanism design; experience in e-commerce or food delivery industry is preferred.
  3. Skills and Analytical Abilities: Possess clear logical thinking ability; (Hard Requirements) Familiarity with SQL and common business analysis methods, strong data sensitivity, and ability to independently analyze business problems and propose optimization suggestions.
  4. Project Management Ability: Ability to independently manage projects from initiation to completion.
  5. Collaboration Ability: Ability to efficiently coordinate internal and external teams, drive the execution of complex projects, and ensure timely completion of tasks.
  6. Language Requirements: (Hard Requirements) English CET-6 or above. A strong command of English is a plus.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: SAP Automation Developer QA/Tester
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Automation Developer QA/Tester who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and execute test concepts, automated or manual test script for cross platform mobile app SAP Service and Asset Manager and foundation framework Mobile Development Kit for Windows.

Follow SAP’s software quality standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in automation development and testing for mobile applications, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, with Behavior Driven Development, Java, JMeter, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system, Jenkins etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to clarify UI Figma design requirement for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows.

Document test concept, automation processes, test cases and workflows for reference and future improvement.

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to clarify OData Service features and requirement, to ensure sufficient test coverage.

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, with strong focus on usability, user experience, security, performance and feature correctness. Actively collaborate with frontend and backend developers to report functional issues, crashes, and performance problems, and validate fixes and resolution as required. Ensure test plant and results are maintained in the central Global Test Platform system for reporting and traceability.

Provide sufficient documentations on test environment, test results, re-produce steps

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) on any product documentation issues

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Maintain communication and documentation in English. Maintain proper communication and notification with SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

description:
Sales Manager - Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Territory: Latin America

About the Role

We’re seeking a Sales Manager to drive growth across LATAM. You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.

Responsibilities

• Manage and grow key accounts across LATAM, fostering senior-level relationships with brand owners, CDMOs/contract manufacturers, and distributors.

• Develop and execute country- and segment-level territory plans to capture new business.

• Present nutraceutical ingredients to customers, clearly articulating benefits, applications, and go-to-market plans.

• Collaborate with technical, regulatory, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions and product launches.

• Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify white space and protect share.

• Meet and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.

• Represent the company at regional trade shows, conferences, and industry events.

• Provide technical/product support to customers in coordination with internal teams.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional regulations and standards (e.g., ANVISA, COFEPRIS, INVIMA).

Requirements

• 5+ years of B2B sales experience in nutraceutical ingredients within LATAM.

• Strong understanding of nutraceutical ingredients and their applications in dietary supplements and functional F&B.

• Proven ability to prospect, build pipelines, negotiate, and close across multiple countries.

• Language: Fluent Portuguese and strong Spanish; English is a plus.

• Self-starter comfortable working remotely; excellent territory/time management.

• Based in Brazil with willingness to travel across LATAM as required.

• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

title: Marketing Analyst/Senior Analyst
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are looking for a Marketing Analyst/Senior Analyst for Free Fire who will be responsible to lead high-impact marketing campaigns and special projects with autonomy and ownership. This role combines strategic thinking with creativity in a fast-paced, project-based environment where no two days are the same. Ideal for candidates who thrive amid ambiguity, take initiative, and are eager to grow quickly by solving meaningful challenges.

If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we’d love to work with you!

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Exclusivity contract required.

Responsibilities:

  • Campaign Planning: Develop end-to-end marketing campaign plans that align with the overall marketing strategy, grounded in clear rationale and player insights, and bring new innovative ideas.
  • Project Management: Lead campaign execution as project manager, ensuring cross-functional coordination with local teams, global stakeholders, and external partners to ensure high-quality, on-time deliverables.
  • Performance Analysis: Evaluate campaign effectiveness and ROI of marketing levers to inform future planning and optimize spend.
  • Player & Product Insight: Develop a deep understanding of the game and its community to bridge global marketing initiatives with authentic, locally relevant insights.
  • Special Projects: Tackle high-priority initiatives to drive innovation and improve team efficiency, often in unstructured or ambiguous problem spaces.

Main job requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Candidates from other disciplines with relevant experience or skills are also encouraged to apply;
  • Experience: Solid experience working with product marketing, brand management, strategic planning, management consulting, or leadership development programs. Demonstrated experience in project-based, strategic environments and case competitions is a strong plus;
  • Passion for Gaming: Must be an active gamer and regular consumer of gaming-related content;
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken;
  • Specific tool skills: Proficient in Excel (e.g., pivot tables, X/VLOOKUP, basic analysis);
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP.

title: Assistente fiscal
description:
A Daiso é uma rede japonesa de "lojas de variedades", originalmente fundada em 1972. A marca oferece uma ampla seleção de produtos — mais de 70 mil itens no mundo todo — que vão desde utensílios domésticos e papelaria até cosméticos, alimentos e artigos sazonais.

Com mais de 3.620 lojas no Japão e cerca de 2.300 no exterior (totalizando mais de 5.900 globalmente), a Daiso consolidou sua presença no varejo em 28 países, incluindo o Brasil, os Estados Unidos e diversos mercados asiáticos. Presente no Brasil desde 2012, a marca já conta com cerca de 75 lojas espalhadas por cidades como São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Curitiba, Brasília, Belo Horizonte, Florianópolis, Belém e Petrópolis.

Estamos procurando um(a) Auxiliar Fiscal para trabalhar no escritório da Daiso em São Paulo.

Responsabilidades

  • Lançamento, conferência e escrituração de NFE, CTE, Notas Serviço Tomados e emissõa de notas de saídas.
  • Análise de tributação (ICMS, ICMS/ST, FUNDO DE POBREZA, PAUTA FISCAL, MONOFÁSICO, IPI, PIS, COFINS).
  • Apuração e conciliação de impostos (ICMS, ICMS/ST, DIFAL, FUNDO POBREZA e ISS).
  • Elaboração e conferência de guias de recolhimento (ICMS e ICMS DIFAL EC 87/2015).
  • Suporte em obrigações acessórias (EFD-ICMS/IPI, GIA ST e GIA SP).
  • Parametrização e revisão de cadastros fiscais (Protheus).
  • Apoio em fiscalizações e auditorias.
  • Acompanhamento da legislação tributária.
  • Suporte fiscal ao time contábil e financeiro.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa ou em andamento em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com o sistema Protheus (TOTVS) – módulo fiscal, compras e faturamento.
  • Conhecimento sólido em tributação de produtos para revenda.
  • Vivência com escrituração fiscal de NF-e e NFS-e.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e boa capacidade de análise.
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação interpessoal.

title: Quality Assurance Developer
description:
BASIC PURPOSE: Audits and tests enterprise applications with a focus on backend ETL (Extract Transformation & Load) processes and other software modules as it pertains to the creation of data warehouse reporting instruments in order to ensure high quality and integrity of the information. Creates ad-hoc queries to pull information from reporting sources as requested by the business areas.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

Follow established quality assurance standards and processes.

Determine methods, flows, and procedures for better quality assurance and business processes.

Create and documents test scripts to audit data integrity on an ongoing basis.

Test newly developed applications by creating test scenarios and determining whether the delivered product meets the required business requirements.

Analyze and resolve application and data issue problems as these arise.

Document production processes and objects to allow for a better understanding for both the IT team as well as the user community.

Handle ad-hoc queries from the data warehouse for the end users as needed.

Perform other job related functions as assigned.

EDUCATION: Bachelor’s Degree in a technical, MIS or related business degree from an accredited institution of study; or any equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

EXPERIENCE: Minimum of 2 years of data quality assurance experience, preferably in data warehousing or reporting.

2 years experience in quality assurance testing, preferably in the area of data integrity assessment. Preferably have at least 2 or more years of travel industry experience. Experienced working in a fast paced environment where shifting priorities are common.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS: Data analysis and troubleshooting skills with large amounts of data is required. Ability to synthesize and rollup information in various forms through the use of Structured Query Language (SQL) and procedural language (PL/SQL) on an Oracle database platform is highly desired along with strong knowledge of relational databases and their inner workings (tables/indexes/triggers, etc.) Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to resolve application and data issue problems quickly. Interpersonal skills in order to effectively interact with business users, systems analysts, developers, management and IT team members. Verbal and written communication skills for efficient and effective problem resolution and ongoing documentation of process flow. Ability to work in a team based environment. Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and shift priorities per changing business demands. Knowledge of Hyperion Interactive Reporting or any other enterprise reporting or Business Intelligence platform is a plus.

title: Analista de Garantias Sênior
description:
Venha fazer parte do nosso Time de Garantias!

Nossa área é essencial para a segurança e solidez das operações de crédito do Banco Industrial do Brasil. Atuamos com responsabilidade e precisão no controle, análise e monitoramento das garantias atreladas às operações, assegurando a conformidade com políticas internas e normativos regulatórios.

Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado e proativo, com sólida experiência em garantias bancárias e conhecimento aprofundado sobre alienações fiduciárias, cessões fiduciárias e garantias do agronegócio. Se você tem atenção aos detalhes, visão de risco e paixão por excelência operacional, venha crescer com a gente!

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Analisar, registrar e controlar garantias vinculadas às operações de crédito, incluindo:
  • Duplicatas;
  • Aplicações financeiras;
  • Recebíveis de cartão de crédito;
  • Cessão de direitos creditórios;
  • Alienação fiduciária (estoques, imóveis, veículos, equipamentos);
  • Garantias agro (ex: CDA, WA);
  • Avaliar e validar documentação jurídica associada às garantias (contratos de alienação e cessão fiduciária);
  • Realizar o acompanhamento e monitoramento do valor das garantias, inclusive a liberação de excedentes;
  • Apoiar os times de Crédito, Jurídico e Compliance com informações e documentação de garantias;

title: Consultor de Vendas - Loja Física São Paulo
description:
Sobre Nós (A Cultura Zahil)

Somos uma referência consolidada de 39 anos no mercado brasileiro na importação e distribuição de vinhos. Nosso portfólio possui mais de 400 rótulos de 70 produtores de 15 países, presentes em mais de 4.000 pontos de venda em todo o país. Acreditamos que o vinho é capaz de conectar pessoas e criar momentos únicos.

O Perfil que Buscamos:

Você é uma pessoa naturalmente curiosa e orientada a resultados , que enxerga cada cliente como uma oportunidade única de encantamento. Tem a maturidade para trabalhar com autonomia na loja, buscando atingir suas metas, e a criatividade para criar experiências memoráveis para o consumidor, dentro de um ambiente que valoriza tanto a tradição quanto a evolução.

Características que nos inspiram:

  • Mentalidade analítica: Usa o perfil do cliente para fundamentar decisões criativas na venda.
  • Visão estratégica: Enxerga o panorama completo da loja (metas, estoque, cliente) antes de agir.
  • Adaptabilidade: Aprende rapidamente sobre novos rótulos e se reinventa conforme o fluxo de clientes.
  • Proatividade: Antecipa necessidades do cliente e propõe soluções (harmonizações, presentes).
  • Resiliência: Transforma um "não" ou um desafio (um cliente que não sabe o que quer) em uma oportunidade de fidelização.

Descrição do Cargo:

O(A) Consultor(a) de Vendas é a pessoa fundamental para conectar nosso portfólio de vinhos ao cliente final. Ele(a) é a "cara" da Zahil na loja, responsável por traduzir a complexidade e a história de cada garrafa em uma linguagem acessível e encantadora. É preciso ter agilidade para entender o que o cliente busca (muitas vezes, sem ele saber dizer), flexibilidade para navegar entre diferentes perfis de consumidores e uma vontade de aprender constantemente. Sua função é transformar o atendimento consultivo em resultados de vendas, fidelizando clientes e garantindo o bom funcionamento da loja.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prestar atendimento consultivo de excelência, identificando o perfil de gosto, ocasião e orçamento de cada cliente.

  • Organizar e acompanhar degustações, "mini feiras" e eventos na loja, analisando o retorno de cada ação.
  • Garantir a organização do salão de vendas, incluindo reposição de produtos, precificação e Visual Merchandising.
  • Manter-se informado sobre todas as comunicações da Zahil, chegada de produtos, mudanças de preços, promoções e novas tabelas de trabalho.
  • Transmitir à gerência da loja as dificuldades, demandas dos clientes ou oportunidades de melhoria percebidas no dia a dia.
  • Apoiar no uso do sistema interno de faturamento da loja, CRM e no cadastro de clientes.

  • Escolaridade: Desejável graduação completa ou curso técnico.

  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.

  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.

title: Manager, Paperboard Sales (Americas), APRIL
description:
About APRIL

Asia Pacific Resources International Limited (APRIL) Group is one of the world’s leading producers of pulp and paper, known for technological excellence, efficiency, and sustainable forest management. Our flagship PaperOne™ brand and other products are used daily in packaging, printing, and writing applications, and sold in over 70 countries. With operations in Riau Province, Sumatra, Indonesia, APRIL employs around 9,000 people directly and supports more than 90,000 livelihoods through its wider ecosystem, contributing to sustainable growth and community development.

More details of APRIL at:

About the Role

Paperboard Sales Manager (Americas) will develop APRIL’s commercial growth across North and Latin American markets. The role focuses on executing sales plans, developing customer accounts, and expanding APRIL’s market footprint for its paperboard products. Working closely with the regional and global sales teams, the incumbent will drive day-to-day sales activities, monitor market trends, and strengthen customer relationships to achieve sustainable growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Execution & Market Development

  • Responsible for sales activities and achievement of sales targets for the paperboard business.
  • Implement regional sales plans and achieve volume, revenue, and margin targets.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities across assigned markets.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers, distributors, and channel partners.

Account Management & Customer Service

  • Manage assigned key accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely order fulfilment, delivery, and payment collection.
  • Support resolution of customer issues and service improvement initiatives.

Market Intelligence & Reporting

  • Track market trends, competitor activity, and pricing movements.
  • Prepare regular sales reports, forecasts, and insights to support management decisions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align market insights with business priorities.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with supply chain, logistics, and finance teams to ensure smooth execution.
  • Support regional marketing or promotional initiatives to strengthen brand presence.
  • Participate in trade shows, customer visits, and business reviews as required.

Job Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, or Science; MBA preferred.
  • 6–10 years of sales experience in the paperboard, packaging, or related materials industry .
  • Experience in managing customer accounts across North or Latin America.
  • Strong communication skills in English; proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese is an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • Sales and account management capability.
  • Strong commercial acumen and pricing awareness.
  • Negotiation and customer-engagement skills.
  • Analytical mindset with ability to interpret market data.
  • Collaboration across multicultural teams.
  • Resilience and adaptability in a dynamic environment.

Personal Characteristics

  • Results-oriented and self-driven, with high ownership and accountability.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust-based relationships.
  • Resilient and adaptable in fast-paced, multicultural environments.
  • High integrity, professionalism, and alignment with RGE’s values and sustainability principles.

title: Events Specialist (Mandarin/Chinese Speaker)
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Events Specialist to spearhead our presence and engagement initiatives within the local market. This role is crucial in building and nurturing strong relationships with key organizations, particularly shopping malls and local businesses, to drive brand visibility, foster community ties, and support our strategic objectives, including the growth of the SHEIN Marketplace. The ideal candidate will be an exceptional communicator, a meticulous planner, and a proactive relationship builder with a proven track record in event management and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key external organizations, including shopping malls, local businesses, industry associations, and community groups.
  • Identify and cultivate new partnership opportunities that align with SHEIN's regional goals and brand values.
  • Act as the primary point of contact and ambassador for SHEIN in regional interactions, ensuring consistent brand messaging and positive representation.

Event Planning & Execution:

  • Design, plan, and execute a diverse portfolio of regional events, activations, and promotional projects, often in collaboration with other partners.
  • Oversee all logistical aspects of events, including venue selection, vendor coordination, staffing, permits, and materials.
  • Ensure all events are meticulously organized, on-brand, and deliver an exceptional experience for attendees and partners.

Budget Management & Optimization:

  • Develop, manage, and meticulously track budgets for all events and partnership initiatives, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to financial guidelines.
  • Negotiate contracts with vendors and partners to secure favorable terms and maximize ROI.
  • Provide regular financial reporting and analysis on event expenditures.

Regional Representation & Communication:

  • Represent SHEIN at regional industry events, meetings, and community gatherings, networking effectively to enhance brand perception and uncover new opportunities.
  • Develop and deliver compelling presentations about SHEIN's initiatives (e.g., Marketplace, new campaigns) to various external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with internal marketing and communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and promotion of regional activities.

Project Management:

  • Lead and manage complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders, such as setting up stands, events, or joint marketing campaigns with shopping malls / industry associations.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks, and implement solutions to challenges that arise during planning or execution.

Reporting & Analysis:

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for all events and partnerships, providing comprehensive post-event reports and insights.
  • Utilize data to evaluate the success of initiatives and inform future strategy development.

Local Travel:

  • Frequent local travel within the designated region will be required to attend meetings and oversee event execution.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Event Management, Public Relations, or a related field.
  • 5 years of proven experience in event management, community relations, and/or partnership development, preferably within retail, e-commerce, or a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing budgets, negotiating contracts, and optimizing resources for events.
  • Strong track record of building and nurturing successful relationships with diverse organizations and stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently, from conception to completion.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with proven ability to deliver engaging presentations.
  • Proactive, results-oriented, and highly organized with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and adapt to a dynamic work environment.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and Mandarim is mandatory.
  • Fluency in English is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel locally as required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the e-commerce or fashion retail industry.
  • Familiarity with the regional market landscape, including key shopping centers and local organizations.
  • Experience presenting to large groups or external partners.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Gerente de Produto Pleno
description:
Estamos contratando: Gerente de Produto Pleno

Na Apsen Farmacêutica, estratégia, inovação e propósito caminham juntos para impulsionar nossas marcas e gerar impacto positivo no ecossistema de saúde.

Além disso, terá a oportunidade de inspirar e engajar nossa equipe de consultores na busca por resultados sustentáveis e alinhados ao nosso compromisso com a ciência e com os pacientes.

Se você tem visão analítica, perfil de liderança, senso de colaboração e é movido por desafios que integram ciência, gestão e inovação, venha construir o futuro da Apsen com a gente.

O que você vai fazer

  • Desenvolver a equipe sob sua gestão, subsidiando seus planos de carreira, delegando responsabilidades e atividades de acordo com os cargos e nível de desenvolvimento dos colaboradores, acompanhando o comportamento, performance, motivação, comprometimento e cumprimento de prazos;

  • Gerenciar e criar planos de ajustes para o PnL (Controle de lucros e perdas) de cada uma das marcas;
  • Gerenciar orçamentos/budget dos produtos, bem como as contas contábeis, direcionado as ações de promoção e investimento dos produtos;
  • Realizar interface com agências de publicidade, fazendo um levantamento das necessidades, para desenvolvimento de campanhas promocionais e planos de mídias para divulgação das marcas;
  • Propor criações de novas marcas, através de identificação de oportunidades de mercado, bem como extensões de linha;
  • Validar com áreas de interesse, a sustentação das campanhas dos produtos, a fim de atender as necessidades da empresa, seguindo a legislação vigente;
  • Analisar as tendências de mercado e comportamento dos clientes, identificando oportunidades de maximização dos investimentos, aumentando o faturamento e ampliando a margem de contribuição dos produtos sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Estabelecer e estreitar o relacionamento com Médicos lideres de opinião, Sociedades, Associação de Pacientes e Parceiros Estratégicos, visando aumentar a presença de produtos Apsen no meio em questão.

  • Experiência prévia na função de Gerente de Produto, preferencialmente no segmento de produtos de alto custo;
  • Pós-graduação desejável;
  • Visão estratégica e analítica, com capacidade de traduzir dados de mercado em planos de ação;
  • Liderança desenvolvedora, com foco em engajamento e crescimento da equipe.

Local de atuação

Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido, com 4 dias presenciais e 1 dia de home office por semana.

Somos um conjunto de aplicativos de negócios em código aberto que cobre todas as necessidades das pequenas e médias empresas: CRM, e-commerce, contabilidade, estoque… Ajudamos empresas a se tornarem mais eficientes, gastando menos!

Como Consultor de Implementação ERP, você irá implementar o software Odoo para os nossos clientes!

Você estará em contato direto com os clientes para ajudá-los a usar bem todos os aplicativos Odoo (eCommerce, Produção, Inventário, Projetos, Website...). Portanto, você analisará as necessidades deles, projetará a solução, configurará os fluxos e fornecerá sessões de treinamento . Você também apoiará o crescimento da nossa rede de parceiros. Você ajudará e treinará nossos parceiros, de todo o mundo, a implementar os projetos de seus clientes e a se tornarem especialistas em Odoo.

Responsabilidades e dia a dia:

  • Analisar e mapear as necessidades do cliente e seus requisitos;
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes durante a implementação do Odoo;
  • Sugerir fluxos de negócios de acordo com as soluções acordadas;
  • Gerenciar projetos do início ao fim, integrando usuários dentro do prazo e do orçamento;
  • Colaborar com os desenvolvedores do Odoo para executar requisitos específicos, bem como trabalhar com a equipe de vendas no pré e pós-venda;
  • Apoiar com melhorias internas e aumentar nossa rede de parceiros para que se tornem especialistas em Odoo.

description:

Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

- Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. - A ZEISS Metrologia Industrial é líder no desenvolvimento e fornecimento de máquinas de medição por coordenadas CNC e soluções completas para metrologia multidimensional. Somos um parceiro reconhecido do setor automotivo e seus fornecedores, e ainda desenvolvemos soluções de medição para outros segmentos.

- Nossa linha de produtos abrange máquinas de medição dos tipos ponte, braço horizontal (coluna) e em linha, além de máquinas de medição de formas, contornos e superfícies, tomógrafos industriais com tecnologia de ponta que realizam praticamente qualquer tipo de medição com máxima acuracidade, alta qualidade e em alta velocidade.

AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.

If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it.

The Role

We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI.

You will:

  • Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems.
  • Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems.
  • Work on GenAI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.
  • Set up full-stack search engines from scratch that can handle real-world academic workloads.
  • Contribute directly to the infrastructure that makes cutting-edge science more efficient.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will move fast, experiment, and ship production systems that impact thousands of researchers worldwide.

Requirements

  • Strong background in semantic search, vector databases, LLM frameworks, agent-based systems, and document retrieval.
  • Skilled in Python for backend development with the ability to build scalable APIs and services.
  • Past experience deploying systems at scale, including search engines, retrieval pipelines, or embedding models.
  • Ability to design infrastructure that serves hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Experience setting up and hosting APIs with public access while balancing speed, cost, and reliability.
  • A research-driven and pragmatic mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes.

Compensation

$20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside.

How to Apply

Send the following to

Subject: AI Engineer Application

Include:

  1. Your resume.
  2. Details of past projects, especially production-level work with search, retrieval, or GenAI pipelines.
  3. A short note on why you want to design algorithms at AnswerThis.

Applications without these will not be considered.

Let us build the future of research together.

title: Analista de Negócios Sênior - Mercados de Capitais
description:
Somos a única solução completa para o mercado financeiro!

A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro, com mais de 27 anos de atuação no mercado, e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe e mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software, adquirência, processamento e tecnologias para meios de pagamento, contribuindo para a digitalização de instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs.

Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica, a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros.

Responsabilidades

Colaborar com stakeholders de negócio para capturar, validar e transformar requisitos funcionais em especificações técnicas detalhadas, garantindo aderência às normas regulatórias dos mercados de capitais.

Desenhar e documentar processos integração por meio de diagramas UML, BPMN, e diagramas de sequência, evidenciando fluxos de dados, pontos de contato, padrões de integração (REST, SOAP, Messaging, Event‑Driven) e acordos de nível de serviço (SLAs) – incluindo tempos de resposta, disponibilidade e políticas de retry.

Elaborar especificações funcionais e não funcionais (performance, escalabilidade, resilência) e user stories que suportem evoluções de plataformas de negociação, análise de risco e sistemas de liquidação.

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetos de solução e DevOps para assegurar que os artefatos de design sejam traduzidos em código robusto.

Conduzir análises de impacto, provas de conceito (PoC) e estudos de viabilidade técnica, avaliando requisitos de volume de transações, latência e conformidade regulatória.

Apoiar a resolução de incidentes de integração, monitorando métricas de desempenho, e promovendo ações corretivas para garantir alta disponibilidade e performance ideal.

Coordenar testes de aceitação de usuário (UAT), testes de integração e de contrato, bem como preparar material de treinamento, documentação funcional e guias de operação.

Qualificações

Inglês funcional (leitura, escrita e conversação) para interação através de chat e tickets em ferramentas como ServiceNow.

+5 anos de experiência como Analista de Negócios, preferencialmente em serviços financeiros, mercados de capitais ou corretoras de valores.

Compreensão de arquiteturas de integração (SOA, micro‑serviços, ETLs) e domínio de protocolos e padrões: REST/JSON, SOAP/XML, gRPC, mensagens assíncronas (Kafka, MQ, AMQP).

Experiência comprovada na criação de modelos UML/BPMN e na utilização de ferramentas de diagramas e modelagem (Enterprise Architect, Visio, Draw.io, Lucidchart).

Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra).

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager

Location: Americas, Remote

About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.

Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!

Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly driven Product Manager to lead the end-to-end development of Pointsville’s digital products. You’ll turn ideas into impactful solutions by connecting business goals, user needs, and technical execution. This role focuses on defining vision, setting priorities, and delivering products that drive growth, innovation, and long-term value across emerging technologies and financial ecosystems.

What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with company goals.
  • Conduct market and competitor research to identify new product opportunities and emerging trends.
  • Gather and analyze requirements from users, partners, and internal stakeholders to inform product design and prioritization.
  • Translate business and technical needs into clear product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage and continuously refine the product backlog, balancing priorities and timelines across multiple initiatives.

Execution and Delivery

  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to create user-centric designs and intuitive experiences.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution of product features and releases.
  • Lead product launches, define success metrics, and coordinate enablement with marketing, sales, and support teams.

Performance and Improvement

  • Monitor product performance post-launch, analyze user feedback, and drive continuous improvement and iteration.
  • Work closely with compliance and legal teams to ensure all product features adhere to regulatory requirements in the crypto and financial services space.
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment, ensuring all teams are informed, empowered, and accountable.
  • Support documentation, go-to-market readiness, and internal communication for each product phase.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of experience in product management, preferably in fintech or financial services, with direct crypto experience.
  • Demonstrated success of launching and scaling successful web and/or enterprise products from concept to launch.
  • Experience with varying development methodologies and leading cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, fintech, or emerging financial technologies preferred.
  • Skilled in data-driven decision making using metrics and analytics tools.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical conversations.
  • High user empathy, strong prioritization abilities, and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.

We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.
